---
name: Bug or incorrect data
about: Report reproducible behavior or evidence that contradicts a published fact
labels: bug
---

## Expected and observed

Include page/field, source and observation time where relevant. Unknown, stale and zero are different.

## Reproduction / evidence

Steps, relevant revision or safe example. Do not post credentials, private logs or security exploit details publicly.

## Impact and acceptance check

Who is affected? What would demonstrate a correction? Link existing issues before creating duplicates.
